items.label: symptom
items.evidence: if the length of both strings passes a certain threshold, the label on the plot is not rendered as Latex anymore.
items.rationale: Describes the observed behavior and reproduction conditions; does not identify textwrap or the code location.
items.author: mtrocadomoreira

items.label: diagnosis
items.evidence: we call a `textwrap` with a hard break that doesn't know about latex so for very long ones it ends up breaking the rendering.
items.rationale: Identifies the root cause: textwrap wrapping in label handling breaks LaTeX, which is what the fix removes. It proposes no fix.
items.author: dcherian
